visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Loop Instead of Two
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every start and end position is tried with nested loops that add the numbers one by one. Use Kadane's single loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
nums = [3, -2, 5, -1, 2, -6, 4]
best = current = nums[0]
for n in nums[1:]:
    current = max(n, current + n)
    best = max(best, current)
print(best)
solution.explanation: The nested loops try about n squared / 2 ranges. Kadane's algorithm remembers the best sum ending at the current number, so one pass of n steps is enough.
